messages:
Jordan (New Hire): hey team, i just joined and my old employer's final paycheck is scheduled tomorrow. can i set my 401k election here to capture a rollover and also increase my deferral asap? not sure how the payroll transition will affect things.

Nina (People Ops): congrats and welcome! :tada: short answer: you can set elections, and you can do a trustee-to-trustee rollover for the old plan. two separate flows: elections must hit payroll before the cutoff; rollovers go to the custodian.

Carlos (Payroll): logistics: for a newly onboarded employee we process elections according to the onboarding datafeed. if you want a mid-month deferral change, we need the election submitted and confirmed in the portal by 2026-09-05 cutoff to affect 9/15 payroll. we can't withhold from pay that isn't in our payroll system (so the old employer's paycheck is separate).

Jordan (New Hire): got it. so the old employer's final check can't be redirected here. rollover still possible though?

Eve (Benefits Team): yes, rollover is fine. do a direct trustee-to-trustee rollover. please upload the completed rollover form and the old-plan proof (statement or distribution form) to our benefits portal. custodial processing takes ~7-10 business days after we receive paperwork. note: rollovers don't trigger employer match.

Jordan (New Hire): if i bump my deferral to 15% now, can i backdate it to cover the pay periods i worked at my previous employer this month?

Carlos (Payroll): no backdating. payroll systems can't withhold for prior pay periods processed by another employer. if you want to save more this month, consider making a one-time after-tax transfer to the 401k custodian (subject to plan acceptance) or increase the deferral for your next few paychecks. one-time transfer needs the custodian's "employee remittance" form.

Eve (Benefits Team): additionally, remind that trustee rollovers and after-tax transfers count toward annual limits where applicable. if you're eligible for catch-up (50+), indicate that expressly on the payroll election.

Nina (People Ops): action items for you, Jordan: 1) submit 401k election in portal by 2026-09-05 for 9/15 effective date, 2) start trustee rollover paperwork and upload to portal, 3) if you prefer a one-time transfer from your bank, request the remittance and ACH form from benefits. i can DM links.

Jordan (New Hire): thanks! please DM the links. and do managers need to approve the election?

Eve (Benefits Team): no manager approval required for deferral elections or rollovers. manager only approves your start date and onboarding tasks.

Payroll Bot: onboarding payroll file created for Jordan (emp_202609). Pending election confirmation. :gear:
